protocol.comparison: A = R6 deterministic; B = local model-assisted reviewer alone; C = deterministic + reviewer reconciliation. All three run on identical frozen cases.
protocol.execution_policy: The held-out split is executed once. No checker, reviewer prompt, corpus, reference, reconciliation rule or criterion may be changed after execution begins. Historical R4/R5/R6 cases are development material only.

hard_gates.name: No material false acceptance in the hybrid
hard_gates.criterion: C receives USE_TRANSFORMATION on zero of the 12 held-out corruption cases. A single material false acceptance blocks integration.

hard_gates.name: Hybrid detection and non-regression
hard_gates.criterion: C detects at least 10 of 12 held-out corruptions with the expected distinction and exact evidence, and C detects at least as many corruptions as A.

hard_gates.name: False-rejection non-regression
hard_gates.criterion: C false rejections on the eight faithful cases (PRESERVE_SOURCE) are no worse than A false rejections on the same cases.

hard_gates.name: Uncertainty and epistemic attribution
hard_gates.criterion: All four genuine ambiguity cases produce UNRESOLVED/SOURCE_AMBIGUITY under C with REQUEST_CLARIFICATION; the invented-uncertainty corruption produces UNSUPPORTED_UNCERTAINTY under C with PRESERVE_SOURCE; no case contains both UNRESOLVED and UNSUPPORTED_UNCERTAINTY as primary findings.

hard_gates.name: Hybrid adds measurable value
hard_gates.criterion: C adds at least one net detection or classification gain over A on the held-out sample without losing any A detection and without increasing false rejections; or C removes at least one A false rejection without introducing a false acceptance. Equality with A is not sufficient for adoption.
hard_gates.threshold: at least one net gain, no regression

hard_gates.name: Reviewer technical validity
hard_gates.criterion: At least 20 of 24 held-out reviewer outputs are VALID: schema-valid JSON with exact source and transformation quotes. Invalid outputs are reported, not repaired or replaced by a different model.

hard_gates.name: Reconciliation integrity
hard_gates.criterion: No hybrid USE_TRANSFORMATION occurs when a material deterministic finding, an unresolved/disputed finding, or an unavailable reviewer is present. Deterministic constraint findings are never silently removed or downgraded by the model.

hard_gates.name: Evidence grounding
hard_gates.criterion: Every matched held-out expected finding has an exact source span; every reviewer finding used by C has exact source and transformation evidence or is marked invalid.

secondary_targets.name: Hybrid faithful acceptance
secondary_targets.target: At least 7 of 8 faithful cases receive USE_TRANSFORMATION; no more than 1 unnecessary clarification.

secondary_targets.name: Hybrid policy accuracy
secondary_targets.target: At least 22 of 24 held-out cases receive the reference policy.

secondary_targets.name: Reviewer-alone usefulness
secondary_targets.target: B detects at least 8 of 12 corruptions and accepts at least 7 of 8 faithful cases.

secondary_targets.name: Cost and latency
secondary_targets.target: Report total and average local-model latency and token usage. Average reviewer latency below 60 seconds per case is desirable but not a qualification gate.

required_reporting: Per-case outcomes for A, B and C, not only aggregates.
Corruption detection, missed corruptions and material false acceptances for each method.
Faithful acceptance, false rejections and unnecessary clarifications for each method.
Reviewer evidence validity and source-grounding accuracy.
Reconciliation disagreements and whether deterministic findings were preserved.
Model identity, prompt version, token usage, latency, failures and raw-response ledger.
Explicit architectural decision: ADOPT_FOR_FURTHER_RESEARCH, REVISE_HYBRID, PREFER_DETERMINISTIC or STOP_CHECKER_RESEARCH.

decision_rule.ADOPT_FOR_FURTHER_RESEARCH: All hard gates pass. C adds a measurable, source-grounded gain over A without regression. This is permission for further research, not production integration.
decision_rule.REVISE_HYBRID: C is safe but the gain is marginal or mixed, or reviewer validity/reconciliation needs work, or a single repairable hard gate fails while the hybrid remains promising.
decision_rule.PREFER_DETERMINISTIC: C does not add value over A, or B is unreliable and C collapses to A. Keep the typed-constraint checker and stop extending the hybrid as the primary route.
decision_rule.STOP_CHECKER_RESEARCH: C has a material false acceptance combined with detection below A, or multiple hard gates fail and neither B nor C provides meaningful value.
decision_rule.READY_NOT_EVALUATED: No suitable model execution is authorized or qualified. Deliver architecture, contracts, fixtures and offline tests without invented performance results.

notes: The references are author-constructed and provisional, not independent human adjudication.
Passing these gates is experimental qualification, not proof of production safety.
No hosted model calls, Studio communication integration, manuscript changes, commits or pushes are permitted.
The local model is a bounded observational instrument, not an independent semantic authority.
